snippet.title: Blue Wyrm - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Available on itch: https: //saintpesticide.itch.io/blue-wyrm

Your wife - the Blue Knight Lucia did not return home from her journey to slay an ancient evil. Odd beings wreck havoc on the lands nearby. A rumor of a crypt unearthing is spread.

Blue Wyrm is a first-person skill-based action game, where you take upon a role of the Red Knight Gabriel, armed only with  her trusty sword to fight off a tight, but varied roster of enemies in a nonsensical surreal dungeon. Learn the ways to use your movement and position, directional attack variety and timing to perfect your battle technique and succeed in your quest to save her.

Trailer credits:
Footage: http: //www.freestockfootagearchive.com/
